launches.title: Kairos Health: AI Front Desk for Dental Practices
launches.tagline: Kairos Health automates patient engagement for dentists by handling phones and insurance.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Kairos plugs into a dental practice's software, calls patients who are overdue for care, and books them directly into the schedule. It also answers every inbound call 24/7 and verifies insurance.

**The problem** Every dental practice has hundreds of thousands of dollars in revenue sitting idle in their patient management system. It comes from overdue cleanings, unscheduled treatment plans and insurance benefits that are about to expire. The front desk knows these patients are there, but they’re juggling check-ins, phones, and insurance all day, so these calls never get made. Automated texts are easy to ignore, and patients who call in often end up at voicemail.

**What we do**

* Find the patients who should be coming back by analyzing the practice’s data
* Send personalized calls and texts using AI to book them into the schedule
* Answer every inbound call 24/7, so no new patient goes to voicemail
* Verify insurance benefits within seconds

[Video here](https://youtu.be/pxs4TejXZ1Q) 

**Customer Results** 

We are live in 16 locations across the US, including one of the biggest independent groups in Manhattan. For these practices each month on average, Kairos:

* Increases monthly production by 20,000
* Answers 179 missed calls
* Books 46 appointments for hygiene and treatment

**The team**

* **Adhira Tippur** grew up helping out at her mother's dental practices, which inspired the idea for Kairos Health. She previously worked at ClearView Healthcare Partners, a life sciences consulting firm, and The Collectiv, a venture capital firm.
* **Sanjana Kavula** studied computational neuroscience at Rice University. She previously worked at Blueprint Medicines at Sanofi and developed AI models at the Icahn School of Medicine.
* **Aditya Jain** studied computer science at Georgia Tech. He previously worked at the New York Stock Exchange, building large-scale data pipelines for financial trading.
* **Tanush Chintala** studied computer science at Georgia Tech as a Stamps President’s Scholar. He built developer infrastructure at AWS GuardDuty and developed AI-powered call routing systems at Nimbus Health.

**Our ask**

* If you run a dental practice or DSO, book a demo at [kairoshealthai.com](http://kairoshealthai.com). Practices that sign up this month get half off, for life.
* If you know a dentist, office manager or DSO leader, we'd love an intro. Reach us at [founders@kairoshealthai.com](mailto:founders@kairoshealthai.com).
